updates.prompt: On a Cisco Catalyst 9800 WLC running IOS XE 17.9, protect an already associated PMF-capable client from spoofed association requests. The Association Comeback Timer field is measured in seconds. Which steps set the association retry interval to 10 seconds?
updates.explanation: 在题设9800 IOS XE17.9平台，PMF的association comeback timer以秒为单位，配置10表示10秒；D的启用PMF并设置Comeback符合。已协商PMF的STA再次发起关联时，SA teardown保护结合临时拒绝和SA Query，保护原有安全关联。SA teardown是真实机制，并非虚构；C错误在用SA Query timeout代替客户端关联重试等待。MAC过滤不能验证伪造源，802.1X本身也不是此重试定时器。PMF完整性保护不是数字签名，不能承诺强制恶意攻击者遵守重试等待。
